question: Who became the Chief Justice of Jammu and Kashmir High Court in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankaj Mithal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankaj Mithal:**__

 __
 
• He is Chief Justice of **Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court.**
 
• He is a** former Judge of the Allahabad High Court.**
 
• He served as the Standing Counsel for the Uttar Pradesh Awas Evam Vikas Parishad and Dr B. R. Ambedkar University, Agra.
 
• He had participated in the Philately exhibition MTPEX 1976 held in Meerut and JUDIPEX 2016 held in Allahabad on the inauguration of the Sesquicentennial Celebrations of the Allahabad High Court.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir**__

 
 
• Governor - Manoj Sinha (As of March 2022).
 
• State bird - Black Necked Crane
 
• State animal - Kashmir Stag
 
• State flower - Lotus
 
• State tree - Chinar
 
• National Parks - City Forest National Park, Dachigam National Park, Kishtwar National Park.
